bullets.title: META: +4% on SemiAnalysis AI compute report; $250B capex plan and Muse Spark frontier model
bullets.body: Meta surged 3-4% on a SemiAnalysis report mapping its compute ramp to 14GW by end-2027 (7GW by YE2026 + 7GW in 2027), with compute costs tracking well below analyst estimates. Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 was cited as matching or exceeding Anthropic/OpenAI frontier models at 25% lower pricing, and $250B capex is planned for 2027 vs prior $175-225B estimates. EU risk: Meta faces potential €12B fine (up to 6% of revenue) for addictive Instagram/Facebook feed design under the DSA.

bullets.title: NVDA: CEO cites accelerating growth toward $100B/qtr; H100 rental rates up 5-10% July YTD
bullets.body: Jensen Huang told MS that AI growth is broadening across labs, hyperscalers, and sovereigns; GPU rental rates are up 5-10% July-to-date with provider price hikes. Rubin Ultra roadmap is on track for next year, no slip to 2028. JPM's Harlan Sur raised NVDA 2027 accelerator estimates +7% and 2028 +45% (Rubin Ultra 2-die, Feynman 4-die), while top hyperscaler datacenter capex was revised to +80% YoY in 2026E.

bullets.title: MU: Announces $250B US manufacturing investment through 2035; multiple Terafabs planned
bullets.body: Micron committed $250 billion to US manufacturing through 2035, building multiple 'Terafabs' including a New York DRAM megafab currently under construction. Pre-market, MU traded -2.6% amid broad semiconductor weakness, but the long-term capacity commitment is a structural positive. HBM prices are expected to double in 2027 vs. 2026, with HBM4 estimated at $4-5/GB in 2027 vs. ~$2 in H2 2026.

bullets.title: AAPL: $30B Broadcom deal for custom silicon; bullish technical breakout flagged; iPhone memory cost risk
bullets.body: Apple expanded its multiyear $30B Broadcom agreement to produce custom silicon and wireless components domestically, yielding 15B+ chips and funding a $1.5B Fort Collins facility expansion. However, iPhone 18 Pro Max memory costs could rise ~$300 vs iPhone 17 due to HBM inflation, and Apple is expected to raise Pro/Max prices ~$200 while absorbing ~$100 of the increase. Apple also lost its EU gatekeeper appeal under the Digital Markets Act.

bullets.title: Semis pre-market: broad weakness (SNDK -3.9%, INTC -2.8%, WDC -2.5%) despite bullish 2H setup
bullets.body: Semiconductors broadly sold off pre-market with SNDK -3.9%, INTC -2.8%, MU -2.6%, WDC -2.5%, MRVL -2.0%, LITE -2.1%, GLW -1.9%, STX -1.9%. Despite short-term pressure, JPM's Harlan Sur expects 70%+ 2Q beat rates and raised CoWoS capacity estimates for the 4th time in 2026. Intel separately saw its 18A chip profitability delay reported, intensifying AMD competition.

bullets.title: NFLX: Citi/JPM debate; engagement declining, bulls need new narrative catalyst ahead of July 16 print
bullets.body: Citi TMT flagged investor room at NFLX skewed heavily bearish, with engagement (watch time, completion rates) declining despite healthy subscriber retention. Bulls need stabilizing engagement, a credible new product narrative (live TV, bundles, World Cup bids), or a large buyback to shift sentiment. JPMorgan maintains Overweight with a $118 PT, expecting Q2 results largely inline with guidance and FY guidance maintained.

bullets.title: GOOGL: MS raises '28 estimates to $300B+ revenue; sentiment 'overly negative' on TPU/Cloud upside
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's Brian Nowak flagged that Google Cloud visibility is improving and raised 2028 revenue estimates above $300B; the stock trades at low-20s EPS multiple. Citi noted Google Search CTRs +125bps q/q and +2.65% y/y on AI/Max benefits with YouTube spend accelerating. UK regulators also designated Google as a 'critical third party' under direct financial regulatory oversight.

bullets.title: WDC: Wells Fargo raises PT to $730 from $575 on storage demand strength
bullets.body: Wells Fargo raised Western Digital's price target to $730 from $575, citing strong storage demand momentum. WDC traded -2.5% pre-market alongside broader semiconductor weakness despite the bullish analyst action.

bullets.title: SHOP: Upgraded at Stifel; +1.9% pre-market
bullets.body: Shopify was upgraded by Stifel and traded +1.9% pre-market on the rating action. No specific price target or rationale details were disclosed in the alerts.

bullets.title: NOW: Upgraded; +2.1% pre-market
bullets.body: ServiceNow received an upgrade and was trading +2.1% pre-market. No specific firm, price target, or rationale details were provided in the alert.

bullets.title: NET: 52-week high at $276.90 (+43.1% YTD); Scotiabank upgrades to Sector Outperform on frontier AI tailwind
bullets.body: Cloudflare hit a new 52-week high at $276.90 (+0.4% on the day, +43.1% over the past year). Scotiabank GBM upgraded NET to sector outperform, citing expected benefits from frontier AI models driving demand for its network and security infrastructure.

bullets.title: INTC: 18A chip profitability delay reported, intensifying AMD competition
bullets.body: Intel's 18A advanced chip node was reported to face a profitability delay, per StreetAccount. The news intensifies competitive pressure from AMD and comes as INTC traded -2.8% pre-market amid broad semiconductor weakness.

bullets.title: DKNG: Indiana June GGR -38% Y/Y as hold rate falls 570bps; sector-wide sports betting pressure
bullets.body: DraftKings Indiana June GGR fell -38% Y/Y (handle +12% Y/Y) as the hold rate dropped 570bps to 7.1%, versus the overall Indiana sports betting market GGR -18% Y/Y. The weakness was sector-wide: FanDuel -24%, BetMGM -31%, Fanatics -18%; overall hold rate declined 370bps Y/Y to 9.2%.

bullets.title: VST/CEG/TLN: PJM power price rally drives upside risk to utility earnings estimates
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley flagged PJM power price surges driven by hot weather and load growth, with 2028/2029 capacity auction results due Tuesday. Traders see upside risk to TLN, CEG, and VST earnings estimates; PJM Board submitting reliability backstop procurement plan to FERC today.

bullets.title: WULF: 20-year Anthropic lease at Justified Data Campus; ~$19B contracted revenue
bullets.body: TeraWulf signed a 20-year lease with Anthropic for ~401MW of AI campus capacity at its Justified Data in Kentucky, projected to generate ~$19B in contracted revenue over the initial term. First Anthropic capacity comes online in 2H27, ramping into early 2028.

bullets.title: DLR/EQIX: BTIG initiates Buy on both; Citi maintains Buy on DLR into 2Q26 earnings
bullets.body: BTIG initiated Buy ratings on both Digital Realty and Equinix. Citi separately maintained Buy on DLR heading into 2Q26 earnings, viewing recent strategic transactions as net-positives and expecting medium-to-long-term multiple expansion driven by favorable demand and positive renewal spreads.

bullets.title: COHR/LITE/AAOI/AXTI: Optical/photonics names testing 3-month lows; bulls defending support
bullets.body: Photonics and optical stocks including COHR, LITE, AAOI, and AXTI are testing three-month lows with bulls attempting to defend support. LITE pre-market -2.1% alongside semi weakness. The SemiAnalysis META compute ramp report was flagged as a long-term positive for AI optical interconnect demand, but confirmation of a bottom is not yet in.

bullets.title: AMZN/MSFT/GOOGL/ORCL: UK designates all four as critical third-party financial infrastructure
bullets.body: The UK government designated Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and Oracle as critical third parties to the UK financial system, bringing them under direct regulatory oversight. Separately, JPMorgan flagged hyperscaler supply fatigue in investment-grade credit as Amazon's $25B bond deal adds to $132B YTD issuance, with balance sheets becoming progressively more levered.

bullets.title: HUT: Down 4.2% in crypto mining selloff
bullets.body: Hut 8 Corp traded -4.2% amid broader crypto mining sector weakness per the Canadian equities mid-morning alert.

bullets.title: TXN: JPM buyside survey ahead of July 22 F2Q26 earnings; Street consensus $5.21B rev, $1.92 EPS
bullets.body: JPMorgan is canvassing buyside expectations ahead of Texas Instruments' July 22 earnings call, with Street consensus at F2Q26 revenue $5.21B, OPM 40.25%, EPS $1.92 and F3Q26 guide of $5.57B/$2.12. Key swing factor: whether TXN announces further pricing increases for 2H26.
